reviews.comment:
Dr. Meek is very funny and caring. Tests are moderately hard, but he gives practice exams which make it easier. The final exam is the hardest out of all tests.
 Overall if you use his study guides, practice exams and office hours an A is very doable.

Truly love Dr. Meek, he is a wonderful prof. However, his grading criteria can be improved since he made some changes throughout the semester. He relied heavily on PPT, which I prefer worked-out works more, especially for a calculation heavy class like this. Assignments can be lengthy but make sure to understand well. Exams concepts are from them.

Eh he's a cool and funny dude, but the class is disorganized. He works out all the problems by typing them instead of writing it out. Quizzes, midterm, and problem sets are not too bad, but he makes lots of errors. Final is worth 40%, and wasn't well put together.

I stopped coming to his lectures after the first quiz. If you did well in gen chem 2 you'll be fine. He's definitely the better option for BICH 404. Don't be afraid to ask for practice quizzes/exams, he'll give them to you if you ask. 3 quizzes, 3 HW, a midterm, and a final. Final is very heavily weighted and was not partial credit this semester.

He's alright and the class is disorganized a little. He types out all of his examples on the lecture ppts. and solutions for homework and quizzes instead of handwriting them. This leaves more room for error/mistakes on his part. Also, he doesn't offer partial credit on major exams and most problems are like 10-20 pts. each.

The material itself for this course is not too difficult but the quiz questions are 10 to 20 points each. Hw helps if you do well on them. The final is cumulative and 40% of your grade, all multiple choice worth 10-20 pts each. Don't expect partial credit unless he is feeling generous for that quiz. Expect to teach yourself. Unorganized class.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Meek is a nice guy, but he can't teach at all. He does give practice exams and quizzes but if you are off by 0.0002 then its marked wrong. He gives almost no partial credit and his examples are usually wrong on the powerpoint and he hates being corrected. If you have the chance DO NOT take Meek. Be prepared to teach yourself EVERYTHING.

If you a chance to take Dr. Meek it's a no brainer. He's entertaining during lectures, and is great with metaphors that help you understand class material. He is a fair and generous grader, and sends out practice problems before quizzes and exams. The exams are straightforward, no trick questions or unfamiliar topics on the tests. Take this guy!

Dr. Meek did all of this math on powerpoint which made it hard to understand. Things he just skimmed over in lecture because he didn't think it was important or he wanted you to look at outside of class were definitely on the exam. If you ask a questions it will seem like he's talking down to you.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Meek is a great lecturer, he is even more awesome because he gives you a study guide for the biochemistry exams. His exam is based solely on the guide, memorize the guide forwards and backward and you'll do amazing. I don't understand why people struggled so much, he gives you more than a week to study the guide.

Dr. Meek was an awesome prof to have. He was very funny and tried to make the class as fun as possible. He also was accessible to you outside of class which was extremely helpful when it came to the exams. If you know the study guide for the exams you will do good. He wants all of his students to succeed, so he really tries to help each one.

Dr. Meek made classes very involved, making sure he knew everyone's names, and would call on people by name during lecture. If you didn't know the answer, he would help you out and didn't make you feel dumb. Follow study guides, understand the assigned homework, and you'll do well on exams. Go to class as much as possible! HW & exams are only grade

Dr. Meek was an awesome prof! He's a hilarious guy & really cares about his students. His lectures were a bit heavy but he gave out study guides for each exam which helped A LOT. He also likes to call on students randomly during class to answer questions which I did not enjoy so be prepared for that. Very fair & generous grader. Highly recommend!!
